scope: Unbounded role identities with abstract original native role and EXECUTE reachability predicates. Both session and effective identities must lack reachable definers under this selected invoker-only profile. Weaker role-only admission and later ACL reachability changes have countermodels; stable reachability preserves the selected exclusion.
limitations: No PostgreSQL has_function_privilege or complete call-graph/catalog/SQL/Python refinement proof
